tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: There shall not be any case or charge under investigation/enquiry/trial against the Tenderer or convicted in a Court of Law or suspended /blacklisted by any organization on any grounds.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
KSPCB reserves the right to use in-house information for assessment of capability of Tenderer. The decision of KSPCB regarding the tender will be final and binding.

Tenderers are advised to visit the site during the office hours 10.00 am to 5.30 P.M to understand the nature and scope of the work. The tenderers may contact Mr. Sridhar S Malhari (Procurement), for clarification.
Any agency/ contractor/Agency who quote less than the minimum prevailing wages or as per the payment of minimum wages act issued by the Labor department will be liable for Dis-qualification.
Other terms and conditions as per tender document.
The minimum academic qualification of the persons engaged for shift and maintenance duties shall be as per the contract conditions.
Minimum wages as per Labor Department norms & Part of ESI /PF etc., If any increase/decrease in statutory levis will be borne by the Board.
For the successful bidder, the rate quoted by the bidder is only applicable and shall not be entitled for any other charges except, the minimum wages revised by the Govt. of Karnataka, time to time.
For any clarification please contact the office of issue or contact Ph 25581383 2589112.
The quoted rates shall be of including GST.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of Rs.8.39 Lakhs during 5 preceding years. Turnover certificate to be uploaded.
Satisfactory completion as prime contractor/Agency at least one similar works to an extent of 50 percentage of the cost of the work i.e., Rs.4.20 Lakhs.
Tenderer should upload the copies of PAN and GST certificates.

The bidders shall submit the details of work done certificate issued for Annual Maintenance Contract for Electrical Installation, HT works, Lift Operations, AMC for HVAC & Diesel Generators sets handled by them in Government organization State or central/MNC/Public sector since five years as on date of submission of bids. Note- Work done certificate should be issued by not below the rank of Executive Engineer
The Tenderer should possess Labor department registration details to be furnished.
The Tenderer should possess valid EPF and ESI Registration Certificate and details to be furnished.
The Tenderer should upload income tax returns, balance sheet and turnover for preceding five 5 years. 2021-22 to 2025-26

To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e 2021-22 to 2025-26. 1.The Tenderers/Agency/firm should possess valid Class-I Electrical KPWD Registration Certificate/Electrical Inspectorate Registration details to be enclosed.
